setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays one trig on step 1: root C (MIDI 60, C3) at velocity 50, held for 4 steps. Chd1 to Chd4 on the Masks page are E, G, A and C (MIDI 64, 67, 69, 72) and the output is polyphonic. Trig params is open on its parameter list, showing Chord Velocity Mod. Chord Note Strum (1/2), Chord Pattern (-> forward) and Mute Chord Root (X, off) are already assigned, so the root and four chord notes strum half a step apart.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Press K3 to assign Chord Velocity Mod and K2 to return, then turn E3 up ten detents to +10. Tap Play (1,8), then tap it again to stop. In the MIDI strip the notes C3 (60), E3 (64), G3 (67), A3 (69) and C4 (72) carry velocities 50, 60, 70, 80 and 90: each note is 10 louder than the one before, so the chord swells upward.
steps.title: Raise each voice by 10
